title: Attach successful for EPS services and not accepted for SMS services

entities.name: Attach procedure with SMS services not accepted
entities.description: Attach procedure where EPS services are successful but SMS services are not accepted by the network. The MME sets EPS attach result to 'EPS only' and provides SMS services status in ATTACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE indicating attach acceptance. Contains EPS attach result IE and SMS services status IE.

entities.name: EPS attach result IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the result of EPS attach procedure. Set to 'EPS only' when SMS services are not accepted.

entities.name: SMS services status IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the status of SMS services. Contains values like 'SMS services not available' or 'SMS services not available in this PLMN'.

entities.name: Timer T3410
entities.description: Timer used during attach procedure. Stopped when ATTACH ACCEPT is received.

entities.name: Timer T3411
entities.description: Timer started when tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5. Triggers tracking area updating procedure when expired.

entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer started when tracking area updating attempt counter equals 5. Triggers tracking area updating procedure when expired.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: EMM state entered after successful attach for EPS services.

entities.name: Tracking area updating attempt counter
entities.description: Counter tracking number of tracking area updating attempts. Reset to zero or incremented based on SMS services status.

entities.name: EPS update status EU1 UPDATED
entities.description: EPS update status set to updated after successful attach procedure.

entities.name: SMS services not available condition
entities.description: Condition when SMS services status IE indicates 'SMS services not available'. UE stops T3410, resets counter, and enters EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

entities.name: SMS services not available in this PLMN condition
entities.description: Condition when SMS services status IE indicates 'SMS services not available in this PLMN'. UE stops T3410, resets counter, and enters EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.
